queue.claim: The youthful cervicomental angle ideal is 105-120 deg (Ellenbogen & Karlin 1980, five visual criteria), while measured adults often fall at 115-135 deg or more and the angle opens with BMI and age. The engine prior is N(118,12) in canonical pose.
